evidence: Purdue GIS FID 784 identifies Alpha Kappa Lambda (SOAKL), 417 Waldron St.
Independent Indiana LiDAR-derived footprint objectid 409920 (2018) is registered at the same address and compared with current orthophotography.
The saved massing uses the 14-vertex LiDAR roof outline; its visible-roof fit is supported by the orthophoto overlay.
The Purdue and LiDAR outlines have IoU 0.7573 and area values 476.20 m² vs 598.27 m² (20.4% difference); the source Shape__Area/Length fields are also internally inconsistent with ring geometry.
criteria.reason: Building identity and a second official footprint are persuasive, and the LiDAR envelope is corroborated by imagery. The notable polygon disagreement and roof-versus-foundation ambiguity prevent full confidence in the perimeter.

criteria.status: well registered in plan; local conversion and vertical dimensions are approximate
evidence: The reopened mesh bounds are 26.289 m east-west, 48.934 m north-south, and 10.730 m tall.
The asset retains the project campus X-east/Y-north/Z-up identity-transform convention; LiDAR outline was compared with Purdue GIS and Indiana current orthophoto.
Orthophoto coverage is dated 2022–2025, but exact capture date is unavailable; project coordinate conversion is a local geographic approximation.
criteria.reason: Independent geospatial sources and imagery provide strong plan position/orientation and useful scale evidence. The precise imagery date and local conversion limit survey-level precision.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.status: roof and apparent levels supported; vertical scale estimated
evidence: The mesh height is 10.73 m; the builder explicitly labels eaves (6.2 m), primary ridge (9.1 m), and total height as estimates.
The 2022 captioned Kappa Chapter House image visibly shows a multi-level brick house with pitched gables and a prominent chimney.
No measured elevation or floor-height data establishes actual vertical dimensions; GIS Extrution=12 has undocumented units and is not treated as a verified height.
criteria.reason: The building-specific photo supports the broad roof form and multi-level appearance, but the model’s vertical scale remains an unmeasured interpretation.

criteria.status: distinctive features represented from photo; geometry remains simplified
evidence: The 2022 Kappa Chapter House photo supports red-brown masonry, light window trim, repeated windows, covered entrance, multiple pitched gables, and a tall chimney.
The saved preview includes brick-colored walls, windows, entrance canopy, dark roof masses, and chimney.
The preview simplifies the photo’s pronounced stepped facade and complex roof profile; entrance orientation, exact openings, and component dimensions are approximate.
criteria.reason: The model represents major building-specific cues and is recognizable as a sourced massing. The photograph is oblique and unscaled, and the render simplifies several facade and roof transitions.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.status: asset contract and fresh-file portability pass; closed details remain separate components
evidence: Independent Blender 4.5.15 reopen confirms expected scene, collection, one named mesh, identity transform, zero modifiers, no external image dependencies: True.
A new factory-empty Blender file independently linked the exported collection successfully and found exactly one mesh object (256 vertices); no external images are required.
Fresh topology probe measured 256 vertices, 384 edges and 188 faces; 0 boundary edges, 0 nonmanifold edges and 0 wire edges.
All 30 face-connected components are closed; the principal shell has 16 faces, while facade/roof details remain separate closed components.
Structured evidence, source snapshots, preview, builder, build results and portability report are present.
criteria.reason: The previous severe open-edge defect is repaired. The file meets the modular contract and links in a fresh project; separate closed components are a modest integration limitation, not an export blocker.

findings.finding: Keep the roof-envelope versus wall/foundation perimeter uncertainty explicit: Purdue and 2018 LiDAR polygons have IoU 0.7573 and projected areas 476.20 m² versus 598.27 m²; source GIS area/length attributes do not reconcile with their rings.

Building height, exact eave/ridge heights and detailed facade placement remain estimates from an unscaled oblique photograph; obtain measured elevation evidence if survey-level dimensions are required.

Topology repair confirmed: Blender reports zero boundary/nonmanifold edges, with 30 closed components (largest shell 16 faces). Separate closed roof and facade pieces are present within one mesh object.
